build_OFAEncoderDecoder: build an OFA encoder-decoder model with ResNet image encoder and transformer decoder for multimodal tasks
create_OFAEncoder: create an OFA encoder that processes text tokens and images with relative position embeddings
create_OFADecoder: create an OFA decoder with self-attention, cross-attention, and FFN blocks for autoregressive generation
build_MultiheadAttention: build a multi-head attention module with optional learnable head scaling and key-value caching
generate_with_OFAEncoderDecoder: generate text or image tokens using the OFA encoder-decoder with beam search and caching
